newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA posts 5.568 bln peso Q1 backlog.
newsitem.headline: ICA posts 5.568 bln peso Q1 backlog.

text.p: Mexican construction firm Empresas ICA posted a backlog of 5.568 billion pesos at the end of the first quarter in 1997, slightly below the end-of-year 1996 total of 5.662 billion pesos, the company said on Monday.

ICA won contracts and extensions worth 1.151 billion pesos in the first quarter, while the backlog of contracts where ICA participates but which it has not consolidated totalled $209 million, an ICA statement said.

ICA's heavy construction division posted revenues of 336 million pesos during the first quarter of 1997, down from 484 million for the same quarter last year. The division posted operating earnings of 11 million pesos, equivalent to a margin of three percent.
This compared to operating earnings in the same quarter last year of 51 million pesos and a net margin of 11 percent.

Sales for the industrial construction division fell to 685 billion pesos for the first quarter, down from a year-ago total of 1.110 billion pesos. This translated into operating earnings of 101 million pesos, equivalent to a margin of 15 percent, up from eight percent during the same quarter last year.
